Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CURAJ Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at CURAJ?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at Central University of Rajasthan is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Tech/M.E. or equivalent degree in Biomedical Engineering or related fields with valid NET-JRF/GATE/NET, or a four-year bachelor's or five-year integrated degree in Biomedical Engineering or related fields with 60% marks and valid NET-JRF/GATE/NET.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37000 plus HRA as per ANRF rules.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you send your complete bio-data and required documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is CURAJ/BME/ANRF/Ovadetect/01.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Which university is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ).

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position is contractual.
